# Nullapart Copilot Instructions

The canonical coding-agent rules for this repository are in root `AGENTS.md`.

Before modifying code/config/infrastructure/UI:

1. read and follow `AGENTS.md`;
2. read `SECURITY.md`;
3. identify the owning phase in `docs/16-BUILD-ROADMAP.md` and `docs/phases/`;
4. follow `docs/engineering/CODE-STANDARDS.md`;
5. load only task-relevant architecture/security documents;
6. preserve tests, audit, tenant isolation, validation, failure semantics and documentation.

Do not treat this file as a separate policy source. If it appears to conflict with `AGENTS.md`, follow the canonical project/security architecture and fix the adapter rather than inventing a third rule set.

Detailed coding-agent operating model: `docs/ai/CODING-AGENT-OPERATING-MODEL.md`.
